args.title: Document setting S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO in local setup
args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

Add a note in the local setup steps to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO, as the current documentation omits this and causes uploads to incorrectly target AWS.

label: docs
file: docs/CONFIG.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The configuration file docs/CONFIG.md is relevant because it describes the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable and the local setup steps. Adding a note there about setting S3_ENDPOINT when using MinIO will clarify correct usage and prevent misdirected uploads.
